items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: Well Mae West made a living of what she picked up off of Bessie Smith. Her style and all that kind of stuff.

ctx.x: Oh yes. Of course they stay here and I know that I don't even recall the name of the group now. But it was one of the most famous of the rock groups and I was invited to their apartment one afternoon to talk and when I walked in they were sitting there listening to Bessie Smith and had been listening to Bessie Smith for hours.
Well Mae West made a living of what she picked up off of Bessie Smith. Her style and all that kind of stuff. Mae West really picked that up and parlayed it into something.
